definition: One acquired resistance-gene occurrence: one determinant call at one coordinate interval on one replicon in one assembly. The PRIMARY denominator and the grain of this dataset.
question_it_answers: the resistome — what fraction of resistance genes is where
notes: Plasmid share on this denominator is 52.736 %.

definition: One molecule. Mobility typing is a property of the replicon, not of the occurrence.
question_it_answers: plasmid architecture — what fraction of ARG-bearing plasmids is conjugative
notes: A replicon carrying several ARGs contributes one mobility call and several occurrences.

definition: One shared chromosomal context block: the union of the +/-10 kb windows of the chromosomal occurrences that overlap on one replicon.
question_it_answers: neighbourhoods — what fraction of chromosomal neighbourhoods is mobile
notes: Chromosomal MGE association is 30.14 % block-weighted against 46.39 % occurrence-weighted, because marker-positive blocks carry 2.46 ARGs on average against 1.23 for marker-negative blocks. Neither is wrong.

definition: Resampling unit for every confidence interval. Blocks nest within exactly one BioProject.
question_it_answers: uncertainty — how much of an effect is one submitting group
notes: The nominal project count overstates independence; the effective count is quoted beside it wherever an interval is reported.

definition: One event per (genome, compartment): each of the 6,288 genomes contributes AT MOST one plasmid event and AT MOST one chromosomal event, however many resistance genes it carries in that compartment. 3,569 plasmid + 6,186 chromosomal = 9,755.
question_it_answers: the average isolate — how often is a compartment used at all
notes: Plasmid share is 3,569 / 9,755 = 36.586 %. This is a COUNT OF EVENTS AFTER COLLAPSE, not the arithmetic mean of per-genome percentages. That mean is 35.932096 %, a different statistic answering a different question. Both numbers are correct; only the terminology was wrong in earlier drafts.

size: 3 frozen groups for the primary contrasts
definition: A. baumannii, Klebsiella group, P. aeruginosa. All other species remain descriptive.
question_it_answers: host conditioning — does the route depend on who carries the gene
notes: Species groups were frozen before any distance outcome was read.
